title: transfer left open (bind) — review required
description: transfer runs with an open setting: allow-transfer { any; };. Open binds, trust auth, and disabled protections expose the service to unauthenticated networks. This lexical rule flags the setting; the reviewer confirms isolation or hardens it.
remediation: Apply a secondaries-only ACL and verify from an untrusted network.
limitation: Lexical, line-based: matches the setting regardless of network isolation.
